correctness.rationale: The cyclic gap encoding has an inverse and explains each legal slide as local slack transfer. Exact composition counts and gcd(N,3) prove the mod-3 connectivity cases, and degrees/edges follow from explicit moves. The Johnson-triangle dichotomy plus the unique fixed-token packing in an interval of length 3m-5 counts all N triangles and their incidences, with N=8 handled separately. The two independently encoded exhaustive programs passed all tested N=6..74 and N=6..26, respectively; finite tests are only corroboration.

originality.rationale: Six actual semantic research-record queries and two targeted literature searches found no equivalent theorem. Primary results in arXiv:1403.0359v1 (general claw-free reachability), arXiv:2203.16861 (other TS graph classes), arXiv:1605.00442 (chordal/interval algorithms), and arXiv:2208.07199 (different distance-three move rule) were compared by implication. The exact modular solution-graph, number of triangles and incidence stratification are not obtained from those statements. This is qualified best-knowledge originality, not a certification of historical priority.

value.rationale: Densest distance-three ring packings form a canonical infinite graph family. Their motion space has a sharp, qualitatively distinct 0/1/2-defect trichotomy; the two-defect branch is unexpectedly 4-regular and connected yet non-vertex-transitive with a precise triangle-incidence spectrum. These are natural structural invariants of a full reconfiguration graph, not numerical substitutions into the known independence number.
